description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for creating, retrieving a single, and retrieving all employee claim requests via the API.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI endpoints related to employee claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods and test cases for create, get one, and get all functionalities.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data by populating the workflow state machine fixtures before any tests run.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for creating a new employee claim request, using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee claim request via the API.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee claim requests via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create claim request API test.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for retrieving a single claim request.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for retrieving all claim requests.
